perspectives.author: s.a.foodie
perspectives.title: San Antonio’s first Yemeni coffee shop has officially arrived — and it’s a must-visit! 🇾🇪☕ We stopped by @qatra.coffee in the heart of the Med Center and were blown away by the drinks, desserts, and beautiful ambiance. Whether you’re looking for a chill daytime hangout or a late-night coffee fix, this spot’s got you covered. Here are some of their most popular picks: ☕ Drinks: 🧋 Yemeni Latte 🌰 Pistachio Latte (my personal favorite) 🍓 Strawberry Matcha 🥭 Araysi Yemeni Smoothie 🇹🇷 Turkish Coffee 🍵 Specialty Teas 🍰 Desserts: 🧀 Kunafa Cheesecake 🍯 Honeycomb Bread 🍰 A delicious variety of milk cakes & pastries Don’t sleep on this gem, SA — perfect for date nights, study sessions, or dessert runs! 📍Qatra Specialty Coffee - 7302 Louis Pasteur Dr #103, San Antonio, TX 78229 ⏰ Mon–Thurs: 7 AM – 11 PM, Fri–Sat: 7 AM – 12 AM, Sun: 7 AM – 11 PM Thank you Qatra Coffee for sponsoring this post and supporting S.A.Foodie! #coffeeshop #sanantoniocoffee #sanantoniocoffeeshop #sanantoniofood #sana
